name: Bouncy Brain
storyline:
You are Dr. Zomstein, the last mostly-sane scientist left in a decaying world of wandering corpses. Your mission? Brew the ultimate soup, a concoction powerful enough to restore intelligence to the zombie horde (or at least stop them from walking into walls).

Bouncy Brain is a delightfully weird, chill-interactive game where you drop a bouncy brain into a chaotic pinball-like playfield full of soup ingredients. As the brain tumbles, ricochets, splatters, and bounces its way through each level, it gathers components for your soup and racks up points — all with minimal effort from you.
summary: A chill-interactive physics game where you drop a bouncing brain through chaotic undead playfields, gather ingredients, trigger light interactions, and cook bizarre soups in a relaxing, low-pressure gaming experience.
